method: Actual v2 Engine oscillator -> gain -> SVF, no device or WAV quantization. Exactly representable coherent sine frequencies; last two of eight 8192-sample periods, FFT on last period. Sum energy outside DC and every in-band harmonic bin; Parseval weighting. Lower bound on alias energy: aliases coinciding with legitimate harmonics are excluded. Not a total harmonic distortion, hardware fidelity, modulation, or Rack comparison.
